launch_bundle.provenance: The exact binary used by this run; its version matches agent_info.version in all 30 run-leaf result.json files.
launch_bundle.availability: Not publicly downloadable and not included in the evidence; the hash identifies it. Available to maintainers on request.

adapters.note: These are the adapters this run used; their source is unchanged since 2026-09-22, before the run, and the instruction suffix in all 30 print.jsonl files matches them exactly. They are not the adapters proposed in PR #24, which drive dtcoder differently; PR #24 was not used for this run. The gateway runner that launched the jobs is not published; the settings it applied that are recorded in the evidence are listed under topology, timeouts, and runtime_egress_policy.
adapters.redaction: sha256 is that of the unredacted file the run used; the published copy replaces the internal gateway host, its two fallback IPs and the gateway name with placeholders (published_copy_sha256).

harness_modifications.detail: Each task instruction is passed to the agent with this text appended.
harness_modifications.text:
---
Operating rules for this task:
- Complete EVERY requirement end to end. Do not stop after a partial solution.
- Create every file / make every change at the EXACT paths requested.
- Before finishing, re-read the task and verify each requirement is actually satisfied (files exist at the right paths, scripts run and produce the expected output). Fix anything missing.
- When everything is done and verified, reply with DONE.

harness_modifications.detail: dtcoder __print -m <instruction + suffix> --agent tb -y (auto-approve) --cwd <task cwd> --thinking-level high --timeout <s>; one run per task. Harbor enforces each Terminal-Bench task's own agent timeout; DeepSWE job logs record --timeout 5400s, equal to its task.toml.

A tarball with uv/uvx and a standalone CPython (3.13.9 observed) is uploaded and extracted into /root before the agent starts, intended for offline verifier dependency installs. Terminal-Bench (environment_mode=shared): the verifier runs in the agent's container, so the preload is available to both; the preloaded interpreter is visible in at least one verifier's output (gcode-to-text). DeepSWE: verifiers run in a separate image, so the preload reaches only the agent container; no use of it by the agent was observed.

<internal-gateway-host> is pinned to its resolved IPs plus two fallback IPs (redacted here; hard-coded in the adapter; in this run they were also the resolved addresses). The Pier adapter does not do this.

After the agent exits or times out, the adapter lists the task filesystem (POSTRUN_ls.txt) and copies dtcoder's per-round request/response capture to agent/dogfood/. The latter is omitted from the published evidence.

topology: Local Docker on one host; no Runta golden checkpoint and no fresh restore. The gateway launched the 30 tasks 8 at a time, each as its own job: Harbor 0.22.0 for the 21 Terminal-Bench tasks (n_concurrent_trials 1), Pier 0.3.1 for the 9 DeepSWE tasks (n_concurrent_trials 4, one task per job). The dtcoder binary is uploaded into each task container and calls Kimi K3 over the provider's anthropic-messages wire.

resources.host: 32 vCPU x86_64, 251 GiB RAM, Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS (kernel 6.8.0-139), Docker 29.7.1 (host inventory, not recorded in the evidence)
resources.note: No Runta-controlled per-task vCPU/memory/disk; any per-task limits are those Harbor/Pier apply from each task definition on local Docker. Up to 8 task containers shared the host at once.

deep-swe.note: Local DeepSWE corpus, not a git checkout. Task images are referenced by tag in each trial's agent-build-context/Dockerfile; lock.json records a digest of the local task directory, not of the image. Three tags differ from the frozen tasks/*/task.toml in this repo by a -v1.1 suffix: expr-try-catch-errors, httpx-multipart-response-parsing, python-statemachine-state-data-scoping. Equivalence with benchmark.json reproduction_ref 435ee89e is not established.

canonical: Not the first valid attempt of the benchmark configuration: this run was chosen after the fact as the highest-scoring of 37 complete development sweeps. It is the first and only sweep of this build.

selection.providers: 36 via the internal model gateway; 1 (2026-09-22 21:41, 21/30) via Kimi's official API. That sweep's gateway aggregate is labelled with the internal gateway as provider, but its job configs point at api.moonshot.cn.
selection.partial_runs: Also run, and not counted above: 5 smoke runs of 1-3 tasks, on 2026-09-20 a Terminal-Bench-only run (17/21) and a DeepSWE-only run (4/9) of the reference build plus two DeepSWE-only attempts in which all 9 tasks were infra-invalid, and a full-scope sweep against Kimi's official API stopped after 22/30 tasks (15 passed). Per-sweep list in TRACES.md.

timeouts.terminal_bench: each task's own official agent timeout, enforced by Harbor (timeout_multiplier 1.0, no override)
timeouts.deepswe_timeout_source: passed by the adapter (5400 s), equal to each DeepSWE task.toml [agent].timeout_sec; timeout_multiplier 1.0
timeouts.gateway_watchdog_note: The gateway also wraps every task (both suites) in a 5400 s watchdog (run.json / completion.json timeout_seconds); no task reached it.

terminal_bench.agent_env: HTTP(S)_PROXY set to a transport proxy (redacted in the evidence). NO_PROXY exempts local addresses, the model host and its two IPs, two other model APIs (api.moonshot.cn, api.deepseek.com), three mirror hosts (mirrors.aliyun.com, gh-proxy.com, hf-mirror.com), and five corporate domain suffixes (redacted).
terminal_bench.note: With environment_mode=shared the verifier runs in the agent's container. The mirrors and proxy redirect dependency installs to hosts reachable from the test host; mirror package snapshots may differ from the upstream indexes.

deepswe.note: No gateway transport proxy or mirror variables. Pier sets its own per-task squid proxy for the agent process only (that is how dtcoder reaches the model host); verifiers do not see it. The model host is the only allowed egress.

cost_basis.coverage: 28/30 tasks. terminal-bench/build-cython-ext and terminal-bench/gcode-to-text were killed at the 900 s agent timeout before usage was persisted. Total and per-pass cost are lower bounds; missing costs are excluded, never zero-filled.
cost_basis.cache_write: The provider reported no cache-write tokens on this wire for any task. fresh_input and cache_write share the 3.0/Mtok rate, so the split does not change cost.

disclosures: Selection: chosen after the fact as the highest of 37 complete development sweeps; of the other 36, four scored 0/30 and 32 scored 15-24 (median 20). Treat 25/30 as an upper-end sample.
The adapters append operating rules to every task instruction, preload uv and Python into every task container, and (Terminal-Bench only) pin the model host in /etc/hosts. See harness_modifications.
No Runta golden checkpoint and no fresh restore per task; local Docker with 8 tasks in parallel on one host. No matched control run.
Kimi K3 via an internal model gateway over anthropic-messages, not Fireworks. Cost is FHE price-table repricing, not provider billing.

Terminal-Bench: environment_mode=shared, public network through a transport proxy; verifier dependency installs use PyPI/HF/GitHub mirrors. DeepSWE: air-gapped except the model host; three image tags differ from the frozen task.toml.

terminal-bench/build-cython-ext: verifier reward 1.0, but the agent was killed at the 900 s agent timeout before usage was persisted; FHE scoring counts a pass only with observed usage, so it is a failure.
Cost coverage 28/30; headline cost figures are lower bounds.
Binary-only harness (dtcoder v1.26423.0-c9b4e7d), not publicly downloadable. methodology_comparable is false.
